priority: Fixed November DiffV2IR, ProtocolV2 and original RGB-only YOLOX-X+ByteTrack Test29.528970687393972; target+5, stretch+10. No new seeds or RGB backbone search.
source_bank: All6 actual Train candidate banks from candidate_train_bank_20261127,27251 frames, frozen detector and existing native paired encoders. Wait for all6 sealed banks and actual producer/controller exit0 before fitting any weights.
model_inputs: Current proposals plus past track state/templates only: geometric cost/IoU, body-normalized displacement and scale, velocity consistency, history age/quality, RGB and IR similarities, competing row/column margins, cue disagreement and quality interactions. No GT identity, label, video name, absolute frame identifier or future observation in features.
labels: Train labels only. Hungarian current-frame IoU>=0.5 with confirmed class1 GT. An unmatched detection is known background only if all valid GT overlap<0.2; ignored/distractor overlap>=0.2 remains unknown. Past track identity uses >=3 known past labels and majority purity>=0.8, committed only after the current association has executed. Unknown labels are omitted from supervised loss, not from the input bank or tracker.
teacher: Roll the original25-frame ByteTrack association causally with paired reliable RGB/IR memories. Observe primary candidate edges before assignment, without modifying costs using GT. Post-step labels update only a separate training-label history. All detector proposals and frames still pass through the tracker.
fit_plan: Two deterministic regularized logistic models: full cues and the same-dimensional RGB-only mask. Fit standardization and weights using the first75% time range of each Train video, use the last25% only for Train calibration/diagnostics, keep the early-fit weights. Equal-video weights, fixed regularization1e-3 and six cyclic optimizer passes, seed0. No class labels or images from Dev/Test fit these parameters.
calibration_plan: Freeze the acceptance threshold from the99th percentile of wrong-edge scores on the late Train calibration portion. Calibrated scores are diagnostics on seen-encoder Train identities, not a fresh unseen-backbone validation. Engineering and actual data coverage must pass before the formal fitting protocol is registered.
scope: The first implementation collects features and labels only. Inference policy, safeguards and all complete-Dev cases must be registered before replay or accuracy selection. Missing IR must fall back to the independently fitted RGB mask; descriptor interventions concern identity evidence while the IR visual detector remains unchanged.
storage: Stream per-frame pair batches from compact banks; no images or new FPN cache, no unbounded candidate-pair disk dump. Keep working directory64GiB and40GiB free reserve. Models/weights and banks remain private; publish small code/configuration/statistics/metrics only.
limits: The research stage follows previously exposed Test results. Future choice uses complete Dev only; no new blind-test claim. Whole-system gains do not establish the independent contribution of IR or novelty by themselves.

fit_parameters.optimizer: six full streaming damped Newton passes; no stochastic shuffle or extra line-search passes
fit_parameters.standardization: equal-video first75% known-edge moments, FP64, scale floor1e-4; same ordinary-feature moments for both models
fit_parameters.objective_weighting: equal video weight and equal available positive/negative class weight within each video
fit_parameters.calibration_quantile_interpolation: numpy default linear, pooled wrong edges from late25% Train only

inference_parameters.ordinary_edges: blend the original IoU/score cost with1-p on eligible ambiguous primary edges; retain original secondary and pending association
inference_parameters.protect: an original continuous tracked match with cost<=0.4 and row/column cost gap>=0.1 keeps its row/column assignment
inference_parameters.unsupported_lost_edges: only body-reachable scale0.5..2 edges with gap2..25, mutual maximum p, probability margin>=0.05 and p>=the frozen late-Train wrong-edge99th-percentile threshold may enter
inference_parameters.RGB_fallback: if current IR descriptors are unavailable, use the independently fitted same-dimensional RGB-masked model; no unavailable IR array read
inference_parameters.shape_render: current observed width/height about filtered center, no state feedback; raw area<=100 uses original filtered box
inference_parameters.unchanged_detector: all cases reuse the same fixed November pseudo-IR visual detector and paired identity encoders; RGB here describes identity evidence only

selection_rule: After all6 complete-Dev cases and all4834 frames, maximize official combined HOTA, then AssA, then IDF1, then ascending case ID. If the winner does not beat the frozen pose+late control HOTA by1e-8, report a negative and launch no new Test. Otherwise freeze native zero, pose+late control and the winner before replaying all7 Test videos15985 frames; never choose per Test video.
